title: Pin the Pawn
description: The pawn is one step from queening. Pin it to the king along the long diagonal so it can't promote, then round it up.

title: Other Corner
description: Same idea, mirrored. Drop the queen onto the diagonal to freeze the pawn, then capture it.

title: Long Diagonal
description: The queen is far away. Find the one square on the long diagonal that pins the pawn against the cornered king.
